description: Wait up to 25 seconds for an email to a mailbox made with create_mailbox. Returns {timed_out:false, message:{from_address, subject, body_text, received_at}} or {timed_out:true}; call again on timeout. Pass `since` (ISO 8601) to ignore mail you've already seen.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp; only newer mail counts.

name: wait_for_email
title: Wait for the next email
